content:
Ravi: heads-up — we're proposing a small rename for the routing header used in platform routing decisions. current header is `x-redwood-route` and we want to make it `x-redwood-route-meta` to better reflect payload shape and avoid collisions with customer headers.
Sam: are we changing semantics or just name?
Ravi: just name. payload unchanged: {route_id, priority, affinity}. but SDKs and console parsing rely on the exact header key so this is a cross-cutting change.
Lina: how urgent? can we opt into both for a while?
Ravi: yes — plan is additive: server will accept both keys for 90 days, emit `deprecation` telemetry when old header used, and a console migration that maps old -> new for dashboards. after 90 days we'll start rejecting old header for new API tokens.
Jess: sdk impact then — we'll need header name change in Python/TS/Go clients and fallback logic. default behavior should send new header but tolerate old on read. sample: ```py
# client side header fallback
headers = {"x-redwood-route-meta": route_meta}
# fallback for older installs
if legacy_route: headers["x-redwood-route"] = legacy_route
```
Sam: can we avoid bumping major versions? a minor/patch w/ opt-in flag would be nicer.
Lina: TS/Go can add a config flag `useRouteMetaHeader: true` default true in next minor. if consumers pin older client versions they keep sending old header. we should document deprecation and add runtime warn logs.
Ravi: console team — mapping dashboards: we'll write a migration script to remap saved queries and per-route metrics. However telemetry keys in the console ingestion pipeline depend on header name for attribution tags. We'll need an ingestion-time normalization that coalesces both headers under a canonical tag.
Jess: ok — telemetry side: emit `route_header.deprecated` metric whenever `x-redwood-route` is seen. that lets migration dashboards show which tenants need client updates.
QA-Ann: any e2e tests planned? this touches routing, quota attribution, and RBAC for dedicated customers.
Ravi: yes test matrix: server accepts both, telemetry event fires, SDK sends new header by default, console shows unified metric. we'll add integration tests in staging with canary tenants.
Sam: rollout UX — suggest feature flag in Console "compat:route-header" so org admins can opt their workspace to enforce new header only (useful for security/compliance). default off until final cutover.
Lina: what about rate-limiting / quota mapping? old header values are used in per-tenant quota buckets for some customers. the normalization must ensure bucket keys remain stable. Conrad from billing will want to be looped in.
Ravi: noted, I'll ping billing. action items: (1) platform: add dual-accept + telemetry (2) devex: SDK changes with fallback and config flag, docs + changelog (3) console: ingestion normalization + dashboard remap script (4) QA: tests and staging canary. target: announce deprecation date next week and start canary early next sprint.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled to staging at 1755554360 by @ravi/platform — notify #eng when live :rocket:
Jess: I'll open PR for Python + TS shims today, include runtime warn and env var RW_USE_ROUTE_META.
Lina: I'll coordinate Go PR tomorrow and add e2e tests.
QA-Ann: I'll add test cases to the routing e2e matrix and verify telemetry event is emitted.
Ravi: thanks everyone — I'll draft the deprecation post for next week's all-hands and ping sales/billing for customer comms.
Sam: small nit — can we add a short migration message in SDK logs referencing the support article ID so customers can self-service?
Jess: yup will add link to docs in changelog and runtime warn text.
Ravi: perfect. closing thread once PRs link here.
